scope: Independent read-only reviews of portable state, generated briefs, API integration and Thesis Lab UI; numerical verification is recorded separately.

findings.issue: A finite relative ratio or axis could overflow during percent formatting.
findings.resolution: Shift the scientific exponent when percent scaling would overflow. Two numerical regression tests and focused independent review passed.

findings.issue: Individually valid endpoints could have an overflowing comparison ratio during URL import.
findings.resolution: Preflight both comparison and landscape before changing existing UI state. A browser regression confirms prior valid cases survive rejection.

findings.issue: Mobile waterfall extrema labels were placed at padded domain edges.
findings.resolution: Place labels at the actual extrema coordinates. Focused Chromium check confirms exact endpoint and label alignment.

findings.issue: A delayed screen-reader announcement could describe a valid result after an invalid edit.
findings.resolution: Cancel and version pending announcements; announce analysis paused. Rapid edit regression and focused independent verification passed.
